# End-to-end test: a plugin whose registration is generated by reflect_generate(),
# loaded, inspected, unloaded and reloaded by a host. Needs RTTR (shared), flecs
# sources and the rpe core sources:
#   cmake -S . -B build-cmake -G Ninja -Drttr_DIR=<rttr>/share/rttr/cmake \
#         -DFLECS_DISTR=<flecs>/distr -DRPE_ROOT=<PropertyEditor>
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(reflectgen_test C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17) # RTTR 0.9.6 headers vs libstdc++ in C++20 mode don't mix

add_subdirectory(.. reflectgen)

find_package(rttr CONFIG REQUIRED)
set(FLECS_DISTR "" CACHE PATH "flecs distr/ directory (flecs.c / flecs.h)")
set(RPE_ROOT "" CACHE PATH "PropertyEditor checkout")

add_library(flecs SHARED ${FLECS_DISTR}/flecs.c)
target_include_directories(flecs PUBLIC ${FLECS_DISTR})

add_library(rpe_core_min SHARED
    ${RPE_ROOT}/src/core/TypeBridge.cpp ${RPE_ROOT}/src/core/FlagsSupport.cpp ${RPE_ROOT}/src/core/OptionalSupport.cpp)
target_include_directories(rpe_core_min PUBLIC ${RPE_ROOT}/include)
target_link_libraries(rpe_core_min PUBLIC RTTR::Core)

add_library(game_plugin MODULE plugin/plugin.cpp plugin/game/Components.h)
target_include_directories(game_plugin PRIVATE plugin)
target_link_libraries(game_plugin PRIVATE reflect::runtime rpe_core_min flecs)
set_target_properties(game_plugin PROPERTIES CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden)
if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU")
    target_compile_options(game_plugin PRIVATE -fno-gnu-unique) # let dlclose really unload
endif()
reflect_generate(game_plugin)

add_executable(host host_main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(host PRIVATE rpe_core_min flecs RTTR::Core ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})

enable_testing()
add_test(NAME plugin_roundtrip COMMAND host $<TARGET_FILE:game_plugin>)
